decisions.statement: The token minted is written into `~/.secrets.env`.
The older token a product had is read only where that name has no value.
The scopes asked for are every scope calendar, drive and mail read between them.
One token is minted, and calendar, drive and mail all read that token.
The token minted is saved rather than left for whoever ran this to save.
The token's value reaches neither the report nor a log.
A login refused after the code reached Google says that code is spent and consent is asked again.
A login refused before the code reached Google is refused as the fault alone.

definition: the command granting the consent Google is reached as Alan on, for calendar, drive and mail
